name: Audio Player
description: Show and play a signal from Auralise, an impulse response (e.g. one of the irs of a Simulate component), or an audio file: a lane per channel (the body grows with the channels), with a Play/Pause button, Stop, Normalize (scale the signal to full level; off by default, so auralisations play at their rendered level), a click in the waveform to seek, and a volume slider. Drag the corner to set the width and the lanes' height. A file plays whole, without pause or seek. A signal of more than two channels (ambisonic) is shown but not played.

inputParameters.name: audio
inputParameters.description: Audio signal (from Auralise), impulse response (from a Simulate component; turn Normalize on to hear a quiet one at full level), or audio file path.
